title: Sudden collapse at home
story: Adult found unresponsive, with gasping. You are a lay rescuer.

title: Collapse at the gym
story: An adult collapses at the gym. Another bystander is nearby.

title: AED arrives
story: Adult has no normal breathing; a helper brings an AED.

title: No shock advised
story: Adult remains unresponsive; the AED reports no shock advised.

title: Fatigued compressor
story: Two rescuers are providing compressions; the first is tiring.

title: Respiratory arrest
story: You are a healthcare provider. An adult is unresponsive, with no breathing but a definite pulse.

title: Opioid-associated collapse
story: You are a healthcare provider. An adult is unresponsive and not breathing normally. Assess breathing/signs of life and pulse together within 10 seconds. Naloxone is available.

title: Adult choking
story: An adult choked on food and is now unresponsive and not breathing normally. You are a lay rescuer. Begin the hands-only CPR/AED pathway.
